summary: Accepted for host curation after independent sealed replay, source-context, scope, compact-validation, and chronology-geometry review. s0298 calls Zhang Jizuo the son of the late Prince of Qi, Zhang Quanyi, which attests that Zhang Quanyi had died but supplies no Western date or inclusive endpoint. The candidate removes only the unsupported strict pre-AD-926 bound from claim-797 and records an explicit unresolved source-specific chronology hold.

sourceEvidence.quote: 繼祚，故齊王全義之子也，故有是詔。

reviewedChanges.reason: The source’s retrospective designation 故齊王全義 establishes that Zhang Quanyi was already deceased when this statement was made, and identifies Zhang Jizuo as his son. It contains no dated death event, no AD 926 endpoint, and no evidence that excludes death during AD 926. Removing westernBounds.before AD 926 while retaining the source text, event identity, evidence, certainty, and an explicit unresolved hold is the conservative supported repair.
